info.title: Trinity API contract
info.description: High-level API flow accepted under A16; security design accepted under A19. Detailed HTTP fields authored under delegated specification work. See api-contract.md for API behavior and security-contract.md for enforcement rules. Not implemented or tested. Examples are synthetic. Amended A8 replaces Clerk with seeded local users and adds login/logout; 22 operations total.

get.description: Role hierarchy includes Analyst and Admin. Before publication Viewer/Analyst land on waiting. Admin lands on setup until configured, then refresh_runs until data is ready. After publication Viewer lands on national_dashboard, Analyst/Admin on explorer. No Admin context is disclosed to non-Admins.

post.description: Only submitted SQL controls query filters. Pin one active publication. A18/A19 allow one read-only SELECT over one permitted table, filters, sorting, grouping, arithmetic, CASE, COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, ROUND, COALESCE and NULLIF. Validate full input and every physical table in one SQLGlot policy module before file download; verify DataFusion compatibility. Reject multiple statements, JOINs, CTEs, subqueries, writes, schema changes, URLs, external readers and custom functions. A trusted supervisor stages authorized Parquet read-only for a separate network-disabled query container with no credentials or Docker control. Output is at most 1,000 rows and provisionally 5 MiB; aggregates use all qualifying input rows. No runtime verification is claimed.

post.description: Commit revocation of the current bearer session before success; other sessions remain valid. Repeated use of a revoked token returns 401 invalid_session. No command receipt or Idempotency-Key.

LocalSession.description: Random local session token. Verify its SHA-256 digest against PostgreSQL auth_sessions and check expiry, revocation, active user and current auth_users.role on every protected request without authority caching. Deny invalid authority; database failure returns 503 auth_unavailable. No client role/actor is trusted. A8/A19; implementation and verification pending.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required for Admin action commands. New intent gets a new UUID. Same key/actor/action/target/body replays the stored receipt before stale-ETag checks. Conflicting reuse is 409.
